summary: Examples of the file lookup reading /etc/foo.txt and with_file reading several files, with relative names searched in files/ of the play or role.
questions: Where does the file lookup look for relative file names?
How do I read multiple files with with_file?

answer_card.title: file lookup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "foo.txt contains {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.file', '/etc/foo.txt') }}"

- ansible.builtin.debug: var=item
  with_file:
    - "/path/to/foo.txt"
    - "bar.txt"   # looked up in files/ relative to the play or role
    - "/path/to/biz.txt"
```
